title: Difference does not establish cause
observed: At t0, the lamp is on and the floor is dry.
At t1, the lamp is off and the floor is wet.
concluded: The leak turned off the lamp.
floorboard: Temporal adjacency and correlated change were promoted into a causal explanation.
missing_evidence: A mechanism connecting the wet floor to the lamp state.
A controlled observation where one variable changes without the other.
Any exclusion of a third cause affecting both.

ferret.intervention: Reproduce the wet floor while independently holding the lamp circuit state constant.
ferret.if_claim: The lamp reliably changes state as a consequence of the wet-floor intervention under controlled conditions.
ferret.if_floorboard: The wet floor and lamp state can vary independently; congratulations on inventing causality.
